blocks.text: Thank you, and please do not feel you have to send everything at once. To keep it simple on your side, I have pulled it all into the single request I promised, so you are working from one list instead of several. It covers the reserve detail, the year-end figures David Sherman will reconcile against your records, and the assumption documentation for the {{fact:f:E-2017-001.client}} valuation. For our file I have you, Michelle Hudson, down as the one contact for the data, so sending it to me is enough and you need not copy the whole team.

On the single line David flagged, I would not read anything into it yet. Differences of that kind are ordinary this early, and surfacing it now is exactly what we want, rather than finding it later in a footnote. If it turns out to be a real difference, Jennifer Vasquez will walk it through with you before any of us draws a conclusion from it, though I do not expect it to come to that.

If it is easiest, send whatever is ready first and the rest as it comes; I will confirm each piece as it lands so you always know where things stand. The one item that helps most this week is the reserve detail, since that is what frees David Sherman to begin.
